title: i66_route
description: Flat lookup against oracles/i66.json, VDOT's own I-66 Inside-the-Beltway calculator: resolves origin/destination (label or node id) to the (start_zone_id, end_zone_id) key a future pricing tool looks up in trip_pricing_i66. No DB access, no traversal — VDOT already enumerates every valid direction+entry+exit trip directly. Design: docs/oracle-tools-spec.md; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Interchange label (e.g. 'Fairfax Drive'), case-insensitive, or the oracle's raw node id (e.g. '4') as a fallback.
Echoes the caller's raw input string.

destination.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

legs.description: Exactly one leg for i66 -- the exact (start_zone_id, end_zone_id) lookup key into trip_pricing_i66. Presence here means the trip is published, not that a priced row exists for it.

error.description: Unknown origin/destination identifier, no direct trip between a known pair, or (unreachable today) an ambiguous match.

valid_options.description: The full interchange label list on an unknown identifier, or the reachable destination labels from a known origin, so the caller can self-correct without another round trip.

examples.error: unknown origin 'I-66 Wset': no matching label or node id in the i66 oracle
